guide_intro: Two ways to test: automatic (the scanner does everything) or manual (you pick the payload and test it by hand).
guide_step1_title: Pick a target with a parameter
guide_step1_body: Paste a URL that reflects input somewhere in the page, like <0>?q=test</0> or <1>?name=x</1>. If the endpoint only accepts POST, fill in the Body field too (format <2>key=value&other=value</2>).
guide_step2_body: Swaps each parameter's value, one at a time, through 13 payloads covering the common reflection contexts (raw HTML, inside an attribute, inside an inline script, a <0>javascript:</0> URL), then checks whether each one survives <1>unescaped</1> in the response.
guide_step3_title: Manual mode: click "Use" on the wordlist
guide_step3_body: Copies the payload to the clipboard. Paste it directly into the URL (in place of the parameter value), into the Body, or send it and read the response yourself.
guide_step4_body: Only payloads that reflected back show up in a parameter's card: a payload that never appears in the response at all is hidden (still counted in the card's footer).
guide_icon_critical: <0>Critical</0>: the exact payload (special characters intact) showed up in the response. The input isn't being sanitized here.
guide_icon_info: <0>Info</0>: reflected, but HTML-escaped (e.g. <1><script></1>), so it looks sanitized here.
guide_context_html: <0>HTML tag</0>: the payload becomes a brand new tag (<1><script></1>, <2><svg onload=…></2>), which works when input lands directly in the page body.
guide_context_attribute: <0>Attribute break-out</0>: closes a quote/attribute first (<1>"></1>), which works when input lands inside an existing tag's attribute.
guide_context_js: <0>Inline script break-out</0>: closes a JS string literal inside an existing <1><script></1> block.
guide_context_url: <0>URL / href</0>: a <1>javascript:</1> scheme, for when input becomes a link's <2>href</2>.
guide_footer_note: This is a reflected-XSS signal check; it doesn't execute JavaScript or check DOM-based/stored XSS. A "critical" finding here still deserves manual confirmation in a browser before reporting it. Only use it on targets you have explicit authorization to test.
no_params_detected: No parameters detected yet, add <0>?name=value</0> to the URL or fill in the Body.
payload_label: Payload (pick from the wordlist below or edit freely)
no_params_found: No parameters found in the URL (query string) or the body. Add some to test, e.g. <0>?q=test</0>.
test_button_title: Load this request into Automatic mode above for further manual testing
batch_scan_description: Runs the same check against every request already captured in Proxy History, instead of one URL at a time. Filter by host to keep it scoped to a target you're authorized to test: leave it blank to scan everything in History.
empty_description: Optionally set a host filter above and click Start scan.
